findings.title: Private-key-shaped benchmark strings reach AER and PROV; no [withhold] table (RT-10)
findings.evidence: Private-key blocks: a 86 files (237 strings), b 21 (55), c 4 (11, = RT-10). Their source is benchmark fiction (dailylife suite data and injection tasks under src/agentdojo/...). L2 a: 1 sampled execution carries a private-key header in message parts, tool_execution args/args_effective and PROV apv:args; c 0. Withholding policy null (RT-10 open), as pre-registered. Not a real secret, so not flagged as security-relevant; values never printed.
findings.recommendation: Keep RT-10 open: decide whether the profile declares a [withhold] rule for benchmark key material before release; disclose in the datasheet.
